description: Assesses the appropriate compliance and assurance strategy based on data sensitivity, regulatory requirements, service type, and organisational constraints.

recommendation.rationale: Systems handling SECRET or TOP SECRET data require formal security accreditation through the organisation's SIRO (Senior Information Risk Owner) and potentially NCSC assessment. Continuous compliance monitoring ensures the security posture does not degrade after initial accreditation.

operationalBurden.staffingImplications: Requires dedicated information assurance team; SIRO engagement; potentially NCSC liaison
operationalBurden.ongoingMaintenance: Continuous compliance monitoring, periodic re-accreditation, risk register updates, and audit evidence collection

costConsiderations.runningCosts: Compliance tooling; information assurance staffing; periodic assessments and audits
costConsiderations.transitionCosts: Accreditation process (can take months); security assessment; documentation; remediation

recommendation.pattern: DPIA-Led Compliance with Privacy by Design
recommendation.rationale: Systems processing special category personal data require a Data Protection Impact Assessment (DPIA) as a legal requirement under UK GDPR. The compliance approach should be led by the DPIA findings, with privacy by design principles embedded throughout the architecture.

operationalBurden.staffingImplications: Requires DPO (Data Protection Officer) involvement; privacy engineering skills; legal counsel for DPIA
operationalBurden.ongoingMaintenance: DPIA reviews (at least annually or on change), consent record management, DSAR processing, and retention enforcement

costConsiderations.runningCosts: Privacy tooling licensing; DPO time allocation; DSAR processing costs; legal advice
costConsiderations.transitionCosts: DPIA completion; privacy engineering implementation; consent mechanism development; legal review

recommendation.rationale: Public-facing government services must comply with the GOV.UK Service Standard and meet WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility requirements. The compliance approach should integrate service assessments, accessibility audits, and continuous monitoring into the delivery lifecycle.

operationalBurden.staffingImplications: Requires accessibility expertise (internal or contracted); service assessment preparation needs delivery manager coordination
operationalBurden.ongoingMaintenance: Continuous accessibility testing, performance monitoring, user research, and service assessment preparation

costConsiderations.runningCosts: Accessibility testing tools; user research; performance monitoring
costConsiderations.transitionCosts: Accessibility audit and remediation; service assessment preparation; user research

recommendation.pattern: Regulatory Compliance Framework with Audit Trail
recommendation.rationale: Services with specific regulatory constraints require a structured compliance framework that maps regulatory requirements to technical controls, maintains comprehensive audit trails, and provides evidence for regulatory inspections or audits.

operationalBurden.staffingImplications: Requires compliance officer or governance team involvement; audit preparation needs coordination
operationalBurden.ongoingMaintenance: Control testing, evidence collection, regulatory change monitoring, and audit preparation

costConsiderations.runningCosts: Compliance tooling; audit log storage; periodic audit costs; compliance staffing
costConsiderations.transitionCosts: Control framework development; initial audit; tooling implementation

recommendation.rationale: Without cloud access, compliance relies on manual audit processes, on-premises logging, and traditional governance frameworks. While more labour-intensive, this approach can still meet compliance requirements through structured processes and documentation.

operationalBurden.staffingImplications: Requires dedicated compliance and governance team; manual evidence collection is labour-intensive
operationalBurden.ongoingMaintenance: Manual control testing, evidence collection, risk register updates, and audit preparation

costConsiderations.runningCosts: GRC platform licensing; staffing; audit costs; log storage
costConsiderations.transitionCosts: GRC platform implementation; process design; initial risk assessment

defaultRecommendation.rationale: When no specific conditions strongly favour an alternative, implementing a cloud compliance baseline using policy-as-code provides automated compliance checking. This catches misconfigurations early and provides continuous assurance without manual audit overhead.

operationalBurden.staffingImplications: Development team can manage with governance guidance
operationalBurden.ongoingMaintenance: Policy updates and compliance finding remediation

costConsiderations.runningCosts: Low; cloud-native compliance tools are often included or low-cost
costConsiderations.transitionCosts: Policy development and initial compliance baseline

commonQuestions: What regulatory frameworks apply to this service?
Is a DPIA required for the data being processed?
What is the data classification and handling requirements?
Are there specific audit or reporting requirements?
Is the service subject to GOV.UK Service Standard assessment?
What accessibility standard must be met?
evidenceNeeded: Accessibility requirements and current compliance status
